large_language_models.name: Large Language Models
large_language_models.description: Advanced AI models trained on vast amounts of text data to understand and generate human-like language.

natural_language_processing.name: Natural Language Processing
natural_language_processing.description: A field of computer science and artificial intelligence concerned with giving computers the ability to understand text and spoken words.

nlp_book.name: NLP Book
nlp_book.description: An introductory educational resource and open-source book covering foundational NLP and language model concepts.

self_attention.name: Self-Attention
self_attention.description: An attention mechanism where a bias term representing positional distance can be added to the query-key product.

relative_positional_embedding.name: Relative Positional Embedding
relative_positional_embedding.description: A method of encoding token positions based on the relative distance or offset between query and key tokens.

t5_bias.name: T5 Bias
t5_bias.description: A relative positional embedding technique that assigns query-key position offsets into learnable bucket parameters.

position_offset.name: Position Offset
position_offset.description: The difference between query position index i and key position index j, defined as d(i, j) = i - j.

logarithmic_bucketing.name: Logarithmic Bucketing
logarithmic_bucketing.description: A binning scheme where smaller relative offsets map directly to unique buckets while larger offsets are mapped logarithmically to handle long sequence lengths.

reinforcement_learning_system.name: Reinforcement Learning System
reinforcement_learning_system.description: A framework involving an agent interacting with an environment to learn optimal behaviors through feedback.

agent.name: Agent
agent.description: The learner or decision-maker, which in the context of LLMs is the LLM itself.

environment.name: Environment
environment.description: Everything external to the agent that provides feedback and a framework for learning.

state.name: State
state.description: The current situation of the environment, represented by context tokens in language modeling.

action.name: Action
action.description: Possible decisions the agent can make, represented by predicted tokens in the vocabulary.

reward.name: Reward
reward.description: Feedback from the environment evaluating the success of an action.

policy.name: Policy
policy.description: The probability distribution over tokens predicted by the LLM given preceding context tokens.

value_function.name: Value Function
value_function.description: A function assessing the expected discounted return for an agent starting from a state and following a policy.
